$comment: Pulse /schema input_schema for an operator Joint Interest Billing (JIB) statement, owner copy. JSON Schema, nested depth <= 3. SYNTHETIC demonstration corpus.

statement_period.description: Billing period printed in the header, exactly as printed, e.g. June 2026.

operator_name.description: Operator issuing the statement, exactly as printed.

property_number.description: Operator property or lease number printed in the header, exactly as printed.

well_name.description: Well name printed in the header, exactly as printed.

owner_name.description: Billed owner name printed in the header, exactly as printed.

owner_number.description: Owner or interest number printed in the header, exactly as printed.

wi_decimal.description: The working-interest decimal printed in the statement HEADER, six decimal places. Copy the header value only; do not take it from a billing line.

lines.description: One item per printed billing row, in printed order. Return every printed row, including rows that continue onto a second page.

line_no.description: Line number printed on the row.

afe_ref.description: AFE number referenced on the row, exactly as printed. Null if the row carries none.

account_code.description: Account code printed on the row, exactly as printed.

gross_amount.description: Gross (100 percent) amount printed on the row. Digits only.

owner_decimal.description: The decimal printed on this line, six places. Copy it exactly even if it differs from the header decimal or from other lines. Never substitute the header value.

net_amount.description: Net amount billed to the owner as printed on the row. Digits only. Copy the printed figure; never multiply gross by a decimal yourself.

gross_total.description: Gross total as printed on the total line. Digits only. Copy the printed total; never sum the rows yourself.

net_total.description: Net total billed as printed on the total line. Digits only. Copy the printed total; never sum the rows yourself.
